application.name: app-prompt-manager-prm
application.description: A sophisticated Electron-based desktop application for managing prompt rulesets with advanced features like format conversion, versioning, tagging, snapshots, and MCP integration

frameworks.ipc: Electron IPC with secure preload bridge

processes.main: Electron main process handling window management, IPC validation, and application lifecycle
processes.preload: Secure bridge providing type-safe API exposure to renderer process
processes.renderer: React UI built with Vite, handling user interactions and displaying prompt rules

key_components.RulesService: Application layer facade orchestrating all prompt rules operations
key_components.FileSystemRulesRepository: Data access layer implementing CRUD operations on filesystem
key_components.RuleSnapshotService: Handles compressed library snapshots for backup and restore
key_components.PluginManager: Manages extension lifecycle with filesystem integration hooks
key_components.MCPIntegration: Model Context Protocol support for agent automation

rules_management.description: Complete CRUD operations for prompt rulesets

features.create: Create new prompt rules with metadata
features.read: Retrieve and display rules with full content
features.update: Modify existing rules with change tracking
features.validate: Schema validation for rule structure and content

organization_features.tagging: Attach reusable tags for categorization and filtering
organization_features.search_filtering: Multi-criteria search across content, tags, and metadata
organization_features.categorization: Group rules by workflow, team, or modality

filesystem_integration.description: Direct filesystem operations with security controls

features.secure_access: Controlled file operations with size limits and validation
features.path_validation: Secure path handling to prevent directory traversal

snapshot_system.description: Point-in-time backups of entire rule libraries

features.staging_restore: Safe restore process with staging area

features.copy_rules: Copy rule content to clipboard for external use
features.format_preservation: Maintain formatting when copying between applications

plugin_system.connector_types: Filesystem integrations and external system connections

mcp_integration.description: Model Context Protocol support for agent automation

features.crud_operations: Full automation support for rules management

observability.tracing: Request tracing for debugging and monitoring

security.ipc_validation: Secure inter-process communication with input validation
security.file_size_limits: Prevent abuse through file size restrictions
security.error_handling: Comprehensive error handling without information leakage

backend.file_operations: Node.js fs APIs with security wrappers

user_interface.description: Desktop application with native window management

features.rules_browser: Browse and search through rule library
features.rule_editor: Rich text editing for rule content

user_interface.responsive_design: Adapts to different window sizes and resolutions

ipc_api.description: Internal Electron IPC API for renderer-main communication
ipc_api.security: Preload bridge with validated method exposure
ipc_api.type_safety: TypeScript interfaces for all IPC operations

mcp_api.description: External Model Context Protocol API for automation
mcp_api.endpoints: JSON-RPC style operations for rules management

version_entity.history_tracking: Complete change history for each rule

unique_differentiators.desktop_focused: Native desktop experience vs web-based solutions
unique_differentiators.filesystem_direct: Direct filesystem operations for performance and reliability
unique_differentiators.mcp_automation: Built-in automation support for AI agents
unique_differentiators.security_hardened: Desktop security model with IPC validation

comparison_context.vs_web_apps: Native performance, direct file access, offline capability
comparison_context.vs_cli_tools: Rich UI, visual organization, integrated workflows

consolidation_potential.integration_complexity: Medium - requires porting service layer and UI components
consolidation_potential.value_add: High - adds desktop capabilities, automation, and advanced features to web app
